updates.new_facts: Rowan is recognized as the physically strongest Sentinel, capable of wielding the heavy Duskmoor chain as a weapon. He defeated a weakened Silas in combat and later struggled to carry Silas's body due to the weight of his grief.
updates.quote: Rowan is called the physically strongest sentinel.Who could carry the chain and use it like a lightweight weapon,but in reality it was too heavy for even for sentinel. That strong rowan asked others to help him carry silas dead body.

updates.new_facts: Arthur is a pure, exceptional dragon and an ancestral enemy of the Duskmoor bloodline. He killed a weakened Silas Duskmoor to complete his mission.
updates.quote: Arthur is a pure dragon and as you know he is exceptional dragon.And on the other hand silas was sick and also had a great fight with rowan.He couldn't survive arthur.

timeline_events.title: The Death of Silas Duskmoor
timeline_events.description: After being defeated by his student Rowan due to an internal sickness, Silas Duskmoor was killed in battle by the dragon Arthur.
timeline_events.quote: when silas dies at the hand of Arthur.while before that when silas wanted to end nyxia,his own student and blood rowan fought him and defeated him.
